messages.text: I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Restored arrow-key navigation between cards, including grid-edge behavior, remembered focus, and scrolling the focused card into view. Modified arrow shortcuts remain available to the browser.

Verification passed: typecheck, all 138 unit and static tests, and all 76 browser tests on the project’s named runtime combination.

The repository-wide formatting check still reports three untouched files: `scripts/replay.test.ts`, `tests/accessibility.e2e.test.ts`, and `tests/layout.e2e.test.ts`.
